Safety 
Precaution

A work 
 order must be issued and the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety 
 category,

Safety fence (rope) with caution marks 
 surrounding the work area,

Wear your 
 safety helmet, safety shoes, and safety belt when cleaning suspension 
 Insulator.

Transformer must be out of service and isolated and 
 proper grounded on 
 all its sides is required.

Prepare 
necessary tools and spare parts after due planning.

Before 
commencing work make sure that the machine is isolated from the power supply and 
make sure again by making use of electric detector that the circuit is dead.

Ground 
transformer bushing terminals while working on the transformer.

Should further information be needed or any particular problem arises which 
are not covered by these instructions such as internal inspection please ask 
Hitachi LTD

sections.text: Environmental Recommendation

Before 
 starting the cleaning of all porcelain surfaces of all transformer wear your 
 breathing mask to protect lung tissues from the dust particulate.
Don't burn the cloth used in cleaning, collect it and send to the dump.

Fix 
 any oil leaks to prevent pollution and save money of wasted oil.

Oil 
 leaks to the ground have very bad impact on the environment, mainly on soil 
 and ground water and eventually on the eco-system. "It takes only I 
 liter of Hydrocarbon spilled in an aquifer to render 1,000,000 liters 
 of potable water useless for human consumption

sections.text: Notes:

Transformer temperature directly affects the life of the 
 insulating material.

Maximum temperature rise limits are specified for the both 
 oil and winding temperature.

In the daily inspection, check not only that 
 temperatures are held within the maximum limit, but also that the 
 temperature lies in a satisfactory range in relation to their values in 
 the test report, load condition and ambient temperature.

Overloading of transformer should be made only in accordance with the 
 applicable standard.
